subject: Investor briefing — investor summary & approvals
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Investor briefing — investor summary & approvals

Team,

Attached is v0.4 of the investor briefing packet for the Craft Capital meeting (attached: 2026-12-13_investor_brief_v0.4.pptx). High-level asks:

- Can product/metrics owners (Marissa & Jonas) confirm the ARR / ARR run-rate table on slide 6 (numbers + sourcing) by EOD Tuesday (12/15)?
- Neha: need legal sign-off on the Risk Appendix (risk_appendix_v1.pdf) — specifically the data retention line and audit log wording. Can you flag any non-starters by Wednesday morning?
- Tessa: run-of-show + investor meeting logistics (12/20) — please confirm moderator + ask for 15-minute pre-brief with Alex from Craft.

Known open items: one slide with pipeline customer quotes still has placeholders; I removed detailed customer logos pending approvals. We need a final freeze by Friday 12/18 at 9:00 PT.

Quick notes: I tightened the narrative to emphasize cost-per-token improvements and the Dedicated offering traction in the enterprise segment. Please add one-sentence comms bullets for your respective sections.

Attachments: 2026-12-13_investor_brief_v0.4.pptx (pptx, 6.8MB); risk_appendix_v1.pdf (pdf, 420KB); MVP_metrics_table.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Thanks — r

Rachel Kim
Head of Investor Relations (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing — investor summary & approvals

Rachel — thanks for the draft. I did a quick pass and attach a marked PDF with inline notes (summary below). Main items:

- Slide 6 (ARR table): I recommend using trailing-12 ARR and call out the December contract that skews Q4. Jonas can confirm numbers; I suggest we add a one-line footnote.
- Slide 9 (customer quote): replace placeholder with a short quote from Craft pilot — I pulled the quotation from the Slack thread (will paste in the comment).
- Slide 12 (go-to-market): move the ‘market sizing’ graphic after the customer case, it reads better in the flow.
- Metrics sheet: the LTV:CAC calc is using FY25 ARR assumptions — I updated the formula (see MVP_metrics_table.xlsx).

I can take the slide-order change and produce v0.5 if you want me to.

On the risk appendix: Neha, the data location language in slide 3 is still vague — we should say "data stored in customer VPC by default; Redwood retains logs 30 days unless customer requests longer retention". Thoughts?

Happy to jump on a 20-min sync.

—Marissa
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing — investor summary & approvals

Thanks — quick legal read. A few items to address before we label the appendix as "Cleared":

1) Data retention wording — the proposed line Marissa suggested is OK as a customer-default statement but we need to add: (a) a disclosure that some marketplace integrations may persist metadata longer, and (b) a contact point for retention requests.
2) SOC2 / audit logs: do not call out SOC2 report availability unless we're in the most recent audit cycle and can provide the bridge letter. If we are still between attestations, say "SOC2-aligned controls" instead of "SOC2-compliant."
3) Contract redlines: procurement sometimes pushes for a 90-day data export window; we should align the appendix language with the legal template we use for Dedicated customers.

I can draft the precise wording for slide 3 and share a redline by Wednesday afternoon (12/16). If we need faster turnaround for the investor meeting, let me know and I’ll prioritize.

Neha Kapoor
VP Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing — investor summary & approvals

Quick logistics:

- Meeting is scheduled for Mon 12/20, 10:00–11:00 PT with Alex Chen (Craft Capital). I booked the small conference room and Teams link — will send calendar invites to Alex + ops.
- Run of show proposal (15 min deck + 25 min Q&A + 10 min close):
  * 10:00 — Rachel: 3-slide executive summary (3 min)
  * 10:03 — Marissa: product & metrics highlight (7 min)
  * 10:10 — Jonas: enterprise traction & Dedicated pipeline (5 min)
  * 10:15 — Live demo / quick walkthrough (5 min)
  * 10:20 — Q&A (25 min)
  * 10:45 — Closing & next steps (10 min)

A couple asks: please add 2–3 bullets for each presenter that call out the one ask we want from Craft (e.g., pilot expansion, early access to feature set, procurement timeline). Also confirm final slide order by Friday 12/18 9:00 PT so I can produce the one-pager for the meeting.

Tessa
Director, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@craftcap.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Investor briefing — investor summary & approvals

Team — thank you for the fast turn. Quick status & approvals:

- Marissa/Jonas: confirmed trailing-12 ARR numbers and I added the footnote on slide 6. Marissa produced v0.5 with reordered slides; I reviewed and approved content changes (see attached v0.5).
- Neha: your redline for the Risk Appendix looks good; I replaced the SOC2 language with "SOC2-aligned controls" and added the retention contact point. That clears the legal callouts for the investor pack.
- Tessa: run-of-show accepted. I added the presenter bullets to the notes section of slides 1–4.

I’m attaching the frozen deck for distribution to Craft: 2026-12-18_investor_brief_v0.5.pptx (final). Alex — looping you here; if you want any additional one-pagers before Monday, let us know and Tessa will expedite.

Next steps: I will upload the final deck to the shared Drive link and send the meeting invite with dial-in. If anyone sees a critical omission, reply-all within 2 hours. Otherwise we are locked.

Thanks — r

Rachel Kim
Head of Investor Relations (interim)
Redwood Inference
